title: Pears poached in clementine and spice

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Pears, clementines, honey, almonds, Greek yoghurt and whole spices are all things a grandparent would keep.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including flaked almonds and Greek yoghurt, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a lidded pan and a small frying pan, and poaching is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Four halved pears simmered covered in clementine juice and 200ml water will soften in 15 to 20 minutes, and the liquid reduces to a light syrup, giving a good snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and coring four pears and juicing four clementines fits 15 minutes, and 15 to 20 minutes of simmering plus 5 of reducing matches the 25 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears, and flaked almonds are the same food as the almonds id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm spiced pears with clementine suit mid-December, and the pears are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, yoghurt and nuts with only 2 tbsp honey shared between four makes a wholesome, appealing snack.
